_comment: Project-level Claude Code hooks. Trimmed 6→3 in chore.hook-trim-and-verify (refs retrospective). Per .claude/rules/git-workflow.md §7.7.2 + behavioral-rules.md §8.

PreToolUse._comment: H1 — 拦危险 Bash cmd(per behavioral-rules §8 + git-workflow §7.2/§7.5.1). Skip echo/printf/cat heredoc 防 false positive on test scripts.

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*(echo|printf|cat[[:space:]]+<<)'; then echo '{}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgit[[:space:]]+(commit|push|merge|rebase|stash|tag|cherry-pick|am|revert)\b.*(--no-verify|--no-gpg-sign|-c[[:space:]]+commit\.gpgsign=false)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: git hook bypass forbidden (per §7.2). Investigate root cause."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push.*-f.*\b(main|feature/dev)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: force-push to main/feature/dev forbidden (per §7.2)."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm[[:space:]]+-rf[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]*(\.claude|docs|database/migrations)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: rm -rf protected dirs (.claude/docs/migrations)."}'; exit 0; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+(checkout|merge|rebase|reset)\b.*\|[[:space:]]*(tail|head|awk)\b'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny"},"systemMessage":"BLOCKED: chained pipe with git checkout/merge eats fatal exit code (per §7.5.1). Use independent Bash calls."}'; exit 0; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

PostToolUse._comment: H2 — sprint merge 后提醒 PROGRESS sync(per §7.7)

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+merge[[:space:]]+--no-ff[[:space:]]+feature/dev\.'; then echo '{"systemMessage":"sprint merge detected. Next: invoke skill my-pm-progress-sync or run /sprint:sync to update PROGRESS.md (per §7.7)."}'; exit 0; fi; echo '{}'; exit 0

SessionStart._comment: H6 — 会话起 work state 摘要 + PROGRESS 行数检查(吸收原 H5 PreCompact 价值)

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" 2>/dev/null; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); LAST3=$(git log --oneline -3 2>/dev/null | head -3 | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's/|$//'); AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count origin/feature/dev..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); PROGRESS_PATH="20260403/plan1a-kong/PROGRESS.md"; LINES=$(wc -l < "$PROGRESS_PATH" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); OPEN=$(gh issue list --state open --repo m42981454-tech/doc 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo 0); WARN=""; if [ "$LINES" -gt 250 ]; then WARN=" | ⚠️ PROGRESS $LINES lines > 250 — invoke /sprint:sync 归档"; fi; echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Branch: $BRANCH | ahead $AHEAD | open issues: $OPEN | PROGRESS: $LINES lines$WARN | last: $LAST3\"}"; exit 0
